input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: § 3.5 (Effect of Termination) deals only with acceleration of accrued charges; no provision anywhere in the Agreement (including §§ 3.4, 11.6, 14.18 and the survival clause in § 14.2) requires IBM to provide transition assistance, return or export our Content, or delete it on a defined timetable. Searches for transition, data return/export and deletion language returned no responsive clause, so the rule's expected clause is absent. We therefore insert the preferred exit provision into § 3.5, which already survives termination under § 14.2, using the defined term "Content" (information, software and data Customer provides) to avoid an undefined "Customer Data" reference.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations in § 3.5
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued charges, so we have added our standard exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance and export within 30 days if the six-month period is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will: (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Content to Customer in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
